Subject: Aurora Financial RFP — identity provisioning & SSO evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and security RFP, I've attached our identity and access questionnaire — we're primarily looking for concrete evidence around SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC model, and admin controls.

High level asks:
- SAML metadata and recommended IdP configuration for Azure AD and Okta.
- SCIM provisioning matrix (attributes supported, bulk provisioning, deprovisioning flow).
- RBAC roles and ability to create custom roles + examples of least-privilege role configs.

Hi James — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. We're happy to provide the materials you requested. High-level plan from our side:

1) SAML/OIDC — provide a SAML metadata bundle, OIDC discovery endpoints, recommended claim mappings for Azure AD and Okta, and a short configuration guide.
2) SCIM — a provisioning matrix showing supported attributes, bulk import/export, PATCH semantics, and deprovision behavior (soft delete vs immediate).
3) RBAC + admin controls — role catalog, how to create custom roles, admin approval flows, and examples of policy enforcement (UI + API).
4) Audit logs — auth event schema and a CSV sample of typical auth/audit records (last 90 days anonymized).

I'm attaching: saml_config_guide.pdf, scim_provisioning_matrix.xlsx, sample_audit_logs.csv. Diego will add a short note about our admin separation-of-duties and how delegated admin works. Marissa — can you confirm we can include the live demo script for the provisioning walkthrough next week?

We can deliver the above as a packet by EOD Thursday (2026-08-27). If you prefer a walkthrough, we can schedule a 45-minute technical session — suggested times in my calendar link below.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Aurora Financial RFP — identity provisioning & SSO evidence request

Adding the security POV and clarifications —

Hi all,

A few technical clarifications and confirmations for Aurora's questionnaire:

- SAML/OIDC: We support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC (OpenID Connect). For SAML we provide a metadata XML (attached) and recommend the following settings for Azure AD: audience URI = https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs, NameID format = emailAddress, Assertion Consumer Service URL = https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs. Assertion signing is required; we support SHA256. For Okta the steps are equivalent — we'll include specific screenshots in the guide.

- SCIM: We implement SCIM 2.0 with full PATCH support, support for groups and users, and a provisioning matrix that documents attribute-level support (see scim_provisioning_matrix.xlsx). Deprovisioning can be configured to either soft-disable an account (recommended) or immediate deletion; we include a configurable retention period and webhook for downstream workflows.

- RBAC/Admin: Our role model includes system roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Viewer), resource-scoped roles, and the ability to define custom roles via API or Console. Admin actions are logged and require MFA for privilege elevation. We have delegated admin features for support teams with granular scope.

- Audit logs: We retain auth and admin event logs for 90 days in the standard plan; extended retention is an add-on. Attached sample_audit_logs.csv is anonymized; columns include timestamp, actor, action, resource, ip, result.

I'll attach a short SAML metadata file and a one-page SOC-friendly summary for inclusion in procurement packets.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_saml_metadata.xml (application/xml)

Olga / Diego / Marissa — this is great, thank you. The packet and the CSV look good for initial review. A couple quick follow-ups:

- Can you confirm the retention policy (90 days by default) can be extended to 365 days for required audit data? If so, please include pricing delta.
- For SCIM deprovisioning, we prefer a soft-delete with a 30-day quarantine window — can you confirm the webhook for downstream processes triggers on deprovision events?
- One last ask: could you add a short export demonstrating role assignment via API (curl examples) to the RBAC section?

If you can add those items by EOD Monday, we'll include the packet in our vendor evaluation next Wednesday. Also, we'll likely request a short 30–45 minute technical call — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Thanks again,
James
Director, Security Procurement
Aurora Financial
